messages:
marta_pm: heads up — need a quick decision on saved-query semantics for the new per-route/per-model snapshots in Console. Do we: bind saved queries to the route (so every model view shows the same saved list) or to the model inside a route (so saved queries can target a specific model+route combo)?

kevin_eng: my vote is model-scoped savedviews. many customers switch models per-route and expect different comparators/filters. binding to route loses that granularity.

ash_router: counterpoint: route-scoped is simpler for teams that care about behavior across models. plus route-scoped makes rollouts easier — one saved query maps to the traffic bucket.

julia_ux: UX tradeoff: sandwich both with a clear precedence. show route-level default savedviews but let users pin a model-specific savedview when they switch models. show a small badge: "model override".

samir_data: telemetry + quota implications: if savedviews can pin model variants, we need to attach sampling + cost previews per savedview. otherwise users will be surprised by token burn when they replay a saved query against a heavy model. ops-bot: note — related alert: historical bulk replays have triggered quota spikes previously.

kevin_eng: implementation note: API shape we discussed earlier could support scope enum: "scope": "route" | "model" and an optional model_id. e.g. POST /api/v1/savedviews {"name": "latency-check", "scope": "model", "model_id": "rw-13b-v2", "filters": [...] }

marta_pm: ok so we have 3 pieces to agree on: default UX (route with model override?), API shape (scope enum), telemetry/cost previews + sampling hints.

ash_router: also need routing hinting in the savedview metadata so runtime can route requests to the right capacity tier when a user replays. tiny schema: "routing_hint": "low_latency" | "cost_optimized" 

kevin_eng: agree on routing_hint. runtime will need a fallback mapping table when the exact model isn't available. we should version the savedview -> fallback policy.

julia_ux: for the Console: show small inline cost/latency pill next to savedview entries. hover expands to per-model breakdown and sample-rate used for telemetry. if model-specific, show a tiny "scoped" label + inline switch to view route defaults.

samir_data: telemetry piece: savedviews should record a minimal eval set (up to 10 canonical prompts) for regression tracking. store them with evaluation metadata: sample_rate, last_run_token_cost, last_run_latency. helps Optimize and regression alerts.

marta_pm: that implies backend support for storing a small prompt-set per savedview and scheduled runs. ops-bot: creating a background job will impact quotas — schedule at low-traffic windows + stagger.

kevin_eng: dev-api concerns: storing prompt sets per-savedview increases object size but manageable. need to decide retention: 90 days? 180? We should default to 90 and allow enterprise override.

julia_ux: defaults 90d fine. Add a compact "run now" button in UI for on-demand re-eval with a warning modal that shows estimated cost using the latest routing_hint and model selection.

ash_router: rollout UX: let's canary by org and then by route. We should gate model-scoped savedviews behind a feature flag for a small cohort to see real-world complexity.

marta_pm: plan summary: 1) default UI shows route-scoped savedviews with model-level overrides visible, 2) API supports scope enum + routing_hint + optional prompt-set metadata, 3) telemetry stores last_run_{tokens,latency} and uses those to show cost previews, 4) retention default 90d, enterprise override, 5) rollout behind feature-flaged canaryed cohort.

kevin_eng: sounds good. I'll sketch API PR w/ schema and runtime mapping for fallback policies.

samir_data: I'll draft telemetry event names and sampling guidance (prefers event: savedview.eval_start / savedview.eval_complete with tags: scope, model_id, route, routing_hint).

julia_ux: I'll mock the small pills and the hover breakdown. will include the "run now" modal copy & cost estimate mock.

nash_router: I'll add a simple mapping table to the routing guide: savedview.routing_hint -> capacity pool fallback.

marta_pm: sweet — can we reconvene Thurs 3pm PT with PR + mock + telemetry doc? add blockers if anything changes. :thumbsup:

kevin_eng: adding a note here: need to confirm quota accounting for background scheduled runs vs on-demand runs — who owns token charges in orgs with cross-team access?

samir_data: good point. we should attribute scheduled runs to the savedview owner by default, with enterprise opt-in for centralized billing.

julia_ux: also check authz: whether savedviews should inherit route-level share settings or have their own ACLs. that'll affect the display of the "run now" control.

marta_pm: put both as follow-ups on the action doc. thanks all!

ops-bot: deploy-checklist reminder: ensure background worker has quota guardrails and backoff logic.
